message.content:
1) **Chapter Title:** The large ornamental title at the top reads **"فَصْلُ السَّمَاكِ"** (Fasl al-Samak), which translates to "The Chapter of the Fish" or "Section of the Fish."

2) **Content Description:** The page presents a collection of Islamic supplications (*du'as*) and prayers to be recited, specifically categorized by different types of fish. It includes specific invocations for eating fish in general, for mackerel (*al-Samak al-Makril*), and for sardines (*al-Kusk*), each beginning with the standard formula "O Allah, bless for us in what You have provided us."
